item.title: developers.circle.com CCTP EVM smart contracts and technical guide

findings.finding: On every listed mainnet EVM chain except EDGE: TokenMessengerV2 0x28b5a0e9C621a5BadaA536219b3a228C8168cf5d, MessageTransmitterV2 0x81D40F21F12A8F0E3252Bccb954D722d4c464B64, TokenMinterV2 0xfd78EE919681417d192449715b2594ab58f5D002, MessageV2 0xec546b6B005471ECf012e5aF77FBeC07e0FD8f78.

Hooks are metadata attached to a burn message; the contracts do not execute them. Iris signs messages at the finalized level for standard transfers (finality threshold 2000); an expiration 24 hours ahead is encoded before signing; contracts audited by ChainSecurity and OtterSec.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Hooks in CCTP V2 are metadata that can be attached to a burn message."; "Hook execution is left entirely to the integrator."; "Circle's offchain attestation service, Iris, signs the message."

item.title: cast reads of CCTP v2 contracts on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Gnosis (2026-10-08)

findings.finding: Both contracts are 2175-byte proxies at the same addresses on Base (domain 6), Arbitrum (3) and Optimism (2): localDomain() returns 6, 3, 2; version() 1; maxMessageBodySize 8192; signatureThreshold() 2; on Base getNumEnabledAttesters() 2, MessageTransmitter owner 0x9c563B7B08C5506C4aae279E1f66658D5f9fD7B8, attesterManager 0xDf265e0329F6A08a772B48191b33bDC624499b84, TokenMessenger feeRecipient 0xBEA3621Ef88850E062cF4baCCaD72877E2c3e4Eb; TokenMinter burnLimitsPerMessage(Base USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) = 1e13 (10,000,000 USDC); Base USDC totalSupply 4,353,798,104,767,051 (4.35 billion USDC).
On Gnosis both addresses have codesize 0 and the Base USDC address has no code, so the contracts are not deployed there.
